paragraphs: I'm applying for the Security Engineering role at Ramp. I was drawn to your work in building a secure data platform and integrating security into your development processes.

My core strengths are in Python and systems-level development, with a focus on building secure, observable, and scalable software solutions. I have extensive experience working with data tooling and cloud environments like AWS, Azure, and GCP, containerizing with Docker/Kubernetes, provisioning with Terraform, and implementing CI/CD pipelines.  My experience with Snowflake, Clickhouse, Fivetran, Hightouch, dbt, Redash, and Looker directly aligns with your requirements.

At a previous role, I engineered a solution that consolidated diverse enterprise systems—including Rapid7, Jamf, and BigFix—into a unified platform. I automated the end-to-end workflow from data aggregation to remediation, which reduced manual effort by over 100 hours per month and improved the organization's visibility and response capabilities across thousands of endpoints. This experience directly translates to improving Ramp's data platform security and efficiency.

My experience in building robust system architecture, implementing strong authentication and secrets management, and disciplined monitoring and alerting to maintain high availability and performance aligns perfectly with Ramp's security needs. I am comfortable owning the entire lifecycle of a solution, from design through deployment and operations, and I am confident in my ability to quickly ramp up on any specific technology stack your team uses. I am eager to contribute to Ramp's mission of building the most secure platform for managing business financial information.
